title: Stitch forecast file
description: One file = one model, one dataset split, one cut-off. P2 (and P1 baselines) write it; P1 scores it; P3 renders it. Area is wound area relative to the first frame: 1 = as wounded, 0 = closed. Closure = 1 - area. Times are hours since the first frame (design.md 5.5).

model.description: e.g. nca_ensemble, nca_deterministic, sim_ensemble, edge_speed, logistic

cutoff_hours.description: t0: the model saw frames with t <= cutoff_hours only

p_close_by_T_hours.description: the T used for p_close_by_T in every forecast

event.description: Time (hours) when closure first reaches 50% (t50) or 90% (t90). If already observed before the cut-off, median = q05 = q95 = observed time and censored_prob = 0.

median.description: null if more than half the ensemble never gets there within the horizon

q95.description: null = open-ended (may not close within the horizon)

censored_prob.description: P(not reached by the last forecast time)

reason.description: one plain sentence shown in the UI

wound_id.description: WHAD position id, embryo wound id, or Zaritsky well

wound.description: physical wound id (WHAD posNNNN); series of the same wound are resampled together in CIs. Optional, defaults to wound_id

part.description: WHAD plate part (I or II); optional

p_stall.description: null until the stall rule is defined (P1-12)

observed.description: Observed curve for drawing (solid line). Include ALL frames; the viewer greys out frames after the cut-off for held-out validation.

members.description: Optional: a few ensemble trajectories (same t_hours) for the 'ensemble disagreement' view. Keep to <= 10.
